title: Wide Register Arithmetic
brief: A hardware simulator represents very wide register values as strings of 0 and 1 characters, most significant bit first, because they can be thousands of bits long. We need to add two such register values.
Implement sumBitStrings(a, b), where a and b are the two register values as bit strings, and return the bit string, in the same format, for the value of a plus b.
